aboutScreen.infoDescTitle: This application allows you to enable/disable ads or recommendations for various apps in Xiaomi (MIUI) devices.
aboutScreen.disclaimerDesc: This application is an independent utility guide. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Xiaomi Inc. or MIUI/HyperOS.

ads_step_0_detail: Mi Music Player is the MIUI native music player which is designed just for Mi Fans. With Mi Music, playing local songs will be much easier.
ads_step_0_steps:
1. Open the **Mi Music** app.
2. Go to Music app **Settings**.
3. Tap on **Advanced Settings**.
4. Turn off Recommendations.
ads_step_0_specialNote: You have to manually find ads setting.
ads_step_1_detail: Mi Video Player is the MIUI native video player which is designed just for Mi Fans. With Mi Video, playing local videos will be much easier.
ads_step_1_steps:
1. Open the **MI Video** app.
2. In **Account** tab Tap on **Settings**
3. Turn off Recommendations.
ads_step_1_specialNote: Can be configured directly in Music app settings.
ads_step_2_detail: Themes app is the MIUI native theming app which is designed just for Mi Fans.
ads_step_2_steps:
1. Open the **Theme** app.
2. In **last tab** Tap on **Settings**
3. Turn off Recommendations.
ads_step_2_specialNote: You have to manually find ads setting.
ads_step_3_detail: Mi File Manager is a free, secure tool that helps you find file faster, manage files easily, and share them offline with others
ads_step_3_steps:
1. Open **Mi File Manager** app.
2. Tap on **three horizontal lines** at the **top corner** of Mi File Explorer.
3. Go to **Settings and About**.
4. Turn off Recommendations.
ads_step_3_specialNote: You have to manually find ads setting.
ads_step_4_detail: Mi Browser is an app from the category browsing, whose license is free which is available in english
ads_step_4_steps:
1. Open **Mi Browser**.
2. Open MIUI Browser **Settings**.
3. Go to **Advanced** > **Top sites order**. If Top sites order option is missing, then look ever option until you find the **recommendations option**.
4. Turn off Receive recommendations.
ads_step_4_specialNote: Applies to the built-in MIUI File Manager.
ads_step_5_detail: Mi Downloads app is the MIUI native downloader which is designed just for Mi Fans.
ads_step_5_steps:
1. Open **Downloads** app.
2. Tap on **three dots** at the **top corner**.
3. Go to **Settings**.
4. Turn off Show recommended content.
ads_step_5_specialNote: You have to manually find ads setting.
ads_step_6_detail: Mi Security app is default security app which is designed for Mi fans.
ads_step_6_steps:
1. Open **Mi Security** App.
2. Tap on **Settings** Gear Icon in the **top corner**.
3. Under **Recommendations** turn off Receive recommendations.
ads_step_6_specialNote: You have to manually find ads setting.
ads_step_7_detail: Mi Security app is part of Mi security app which is designed for Mi fans.
ads_step_7_steps:
1. Open **Mi Security** app.
2. Tap on the **Settings** icon in the **top corner**.
3. Tap on **Cleaner** under **Feature Settings**.
4. Turn off Receive recommendations.
ads_step_7_specialNote: You have to manually find ads setting.
ads_step_8_detail: App Lock protects your app with a password or fingerprint.
ads_step_8_steps:
1. Open **Mi Security** app.
2.Tap on the **App Lock**.
3. Tap on the **Settings icon** in the **top corner**.
3. Turn off Receive recommendations.
ads_step_8_specialNote: You have to manually find ads setting.
ads_step_9_detail: Boost Speed App is part of Mi security aap which is designed to clean memory cache.
ads_step_9_steps:
1. Open **Mi Security** app.
2.Tap on the **Boost speed**.
3. Tap on the **Settings icon** in the **top corner**.
4. Turn off Receive recommendations.
ads_step_9_specialNote: You have to manually find ads setting.
ads_step_10_detail: Manage Apps App is part of Mi security aap which is designed to uninstall apps.
ads_step_10_steps:
1. Open **Mi Security** app.
2.Tap on the **Manage apps**.
3. Tap on the **three dots** and then **tap on Settings** icon in the **top corner**.
4. Turn off Receive recommendations.
ads_step_10_specialNote: You have to manually find ads setting.
ads_step_11_detail: MiuiDaemon and MSA (MIUI System Ads) are background services responsible for device analytics and advertising delivery in MIUI. Revoking authorization stops ad notifications and diagnostic data collection.
ads_step_11_steps:
1.Go to **System Settings**
2. Go to **Additional settings** or **Password & Security**
3. Authorization and revocation 
4. Tap on **MSA and MiuiDeamon**
5. Revoke authorization
ads_step_11_specialNote: You have to manually find ads setting.
ads_step_12_detail: When the recommendations are off, you'll still see the same quality of ads as when its on, but they wont be basen on your behaviour data or your personal information.
ads_step_12_steps:
1. Open **System Settings** app.
2. Go to **Additional Settings** > **Privacy** > **Ad services**.
3. Turn off Personalized Ad Recommendation.
ads_step_12_specialNote: Reset advertising ID in Google settings if available.
ads_step_13_detail: Disable Promoted apps toggle. This has to be done to every folder.
ads_step_13_steps:
1. Tap on the **folder** in which you want to disable ads/Promoted apps.
2. Tap on **Folder Name**.
3. Disable Promoted apps **toggle**. This has to be done to every folder on MIUI.
ads_step_13_specialNote:
Only applicable to MIUI default launcher.
You have to manually find your folder.
ads_step_14_detail: Disable suggestions from Homescreen & Recents menu.
ads_step_14_steps:
1. Open **System Setting**
2. Navigate to **Home screen & Recent**
3. Turn off Show suggestions.
ads_step_14_specialNote: Search bar recommendations can be disabled in Browser settings.
ads_step_15_subtitle: Disable usage & diagnostics, advertising id and personalization.
ads_step_15_detail: Reset or disable advertising id, disable debug logging for ads and disable usage & diagnostics
ads_step_15_steps:
1. Open **System Setting**
2. Navigate to **Google**
3. Choose Appropriate option.
ads_step_15_specialNote: Safe to configure within system settings.
ads_step_16_detail: Personalized Ad Recommendation would allow the operating system to analyze your phone usage and behavior thus throwing ads and pop-up recommendations based on what you’ve searched for in the past or by how you use your Xiaomi Smartphone.
ads_step_16_steps:
1. Open **System Setting**
2. Navigate to **Password & security**
3. Tap on **Privacy**
ads_step_16_specialNote: Can be toggled directly in Security app settings.
ads_step_17_detail: All the ads that appear based on the recommendation of the lock screen can be disabled by following two simple steps.
ads_step_17_steps:
1. Open **System Setting**
2. Navigate to **Always-on display & Lock screen**
3. Tap on **Glance for Mi**
4. Tap on **Privacy Policy**
5. Turn off Recommended for you.
ads_step_17_specialNote: You have to manually find ads setting.
ads_step_18_detail: All the ads that appear on the app vault can be disabled by following two simple steps.
ads_step_18_steps:
1. Navigate to **App vault** (-1 Screen)
2. Tap on **setting** icon 
3. Tap on **Glance for Mi**
4. Tap on **About App** vault
5. Turn off Personalized services.
ads_step_19_detail: All the ads that appear on the ShareMe app can be disabled by following two simple steps.
ads_step_19_steps:
1. Navigate to **ShareMe** app
2. Tap on the **More** icon(top right) 
3. Tap on the **About** button menu
4. Tap on the **Help & Feedback** button
5. Turn off Personalized ads.
ads_step_19_specialNote: You have to manually find ads setting.
ads_step_20_detail: All the content that appear based on the recommendations that can be disabled by following two simple steps.
ads_step_20_specialNote: Can be customized in Lock Screen settings.
ads_step_21_detail: WhatsApp Cleaner is part of Mi security app which is designed for Mi fans.
ads_step_21_steps:
1. Open **Mi Security** app.
2. Tap on the **WhatsApp cleaner**.
3. Tap on the **Settings** icon in the top right corner.
4. Turn off Recommendations.
ads_step_21_specialNote: You have to manually find ads setting.
ads_step_22_detail: Game Turbo is part of Mi security app which is designed for Mi fans.
ads_step_22_steps:
1. Open **Mi Security** app.
2. Tap on the **Game Turbo**.
3. Tap on the **Settings** icon in the **top right** corner.
4. In general settings turn off Content Recommendations.
ads_step_22_specialNote: You have to manually find ads setting.
ads_step_23_steps:
1. Open **Mi Store** app.
2. Tap on **Account** tab
3. Tap on the **Settings** icon in the **top right** corner.
4. Tap on **Notification Preferences**
5. Turn off Personalized Recommendations.
ads_step_23_specialNote: You have to manually find ads setting.
ads_step_24_detail: Stops unsolicited application installation prompts, push notifications, and background updates.
ads_step_24_steps:
1. Open **GetApps** app.
2. Tap on **Account** or **Profile** tab.
3. Tap on **Settings** (gear icon).
4. Turn off **Personalized recommendations** and **Update notifications**.
ads_step_24_specialNote: Can be restricted in App Settings if not in use (com.xiaomi.mipicks).
ads_step_25_detail: The primary system daemon responsible for downloading and delivering ads system-wide.
ads_step_25_steps:
1. Open phone **Settings**.
2. Go to **Passwords & security** -> **Authorization & revocation**.
3. Locate **msa** in the list.
4. Toggle off authorization and confirm revocation.
ads_step_25_specialNote: Revoke authorization in Settings > Passwords & security > Authorization & revocation.
ads_step_26_detail: Tracks user interaction, touch metrics, and app usage data for external profiling.
ads_step_26_steps:
1. Open phone **Settings**.
2. Go to **Passwords & security** -> **Authorization & revocation**.
3. Locate **Analytics** in the list.
4. Toggle off authorization and confirm revocation.
ads_step_26_specialNote: Revoke authorization in Settings > Passwords & security > Authorization & revocation.
ads_step_27_detail: Collects intensive gaming usage data and serves localized promotional content.
ads_step_27_steps:
1. Open phone **Settings**.
2. Go to **Apps** -> **Manage Apps**.
3. Tap on the 3 dots at top-right and select **Show all apps**.
4. Search for **Joyose** and restrict background data or battery usage.
ads_step_27_specialNote: Can be restricted in Manage Apps settings (com.xiaomi.joyose).
ads_step_28_detail: Disables video and banner recommendations injected into weather forecasts.
ads_step_28_steps:
1. Open the **Weather** app.
2. Tap the 3 dots at top-right -> **Settings**.
3. Turn off **Recommendations** or personalized content.
ads_step_28_specialNote: You can disable notifications and recommendations in app settings.
ads_step_29_detail: Removes promotional events and banner ads from the scheduling interface.
ads_step_29_steps:
1. Open the **Calendar** app.
2. Tap the 3 dots at top-right -> **Settings**.
3. Turn off **Personalized recommendations** or cards.
ads_step_29_specialNote: You can turn off personalized cards in calendar settings.
ads_step_30_detail: Removes dynamic sponsored content and news articles from the lockscreen.
ads_step_30_steps:
1. Open phone **Settings**.
2. Go to **Always-on display & Lock screen**.
3. Tap on **Glance for Mi** or **Lock screen stories**.
4. Toggle the feature off.
ads_step_30_specialNote: Can be turned off in Lock screen settings (com.glance.auto.store).
ads_step_32_detail: Monitors system health, battery states, and usage states for unauthorized telemetry.
ads_step_32_steps:
1. Open phone **Settings**.
2. Go to **Passwords & security** -> **Authorization & revocation**.
3. Locate **MiuiDaemon** in the list.
4. Toggle off authorization and confirm revocation.
ads_step_32_specialNote: Revoke authorization in Settings > Passwords & security > Authorization & revocation.
ads_step_33_detail: Prevents the QR/Barcode scanner from phoning home with scanned data metrics.
ads_step_33_steps:
1. Open the **Scanner** app.
2. Tap on **Settings** (gear icon).
3. Turn off **Recommendations** or telemetry consent.
ads_step_33_specialNote: You can revoke recommendations in scanner settings.
ads_step_34_detail: Prevents the system from uploading call logs to verify business numbers.
ads_step_34_steps:
1. Open the **Phone / Dialer** app.
2. Tap the 3 dots -> **Settings**.
3. Look for **Caller ID / Yellow Pages**.
4. Disable online lookup.
ads_step_34_specialNote: Can be disabled in dialer / caller ID settings.
ads_step_35_detail: Google's on-device ad tracking system on modern Android & HyperOS that profiles your app usage to serve interest-based ads.
ads_step_35_steps:
1. Tap **Open Privacy Sandbox**.
2. Tap on **Ad topics** and turn it off.
3. Tap on **App-suggested ads** and turn it off.
4. Tap on **Ad measurement** and turn it off.
ads_step_36_detail: Disables unsolicited app installation notifications, promotional banners, and auto-update prompts from the system updater.
ads_step_36_steps:
1. Open phone **Settings** -> **System apps updater**.
2. Tap on the **Settings icon** (top right).
3. Turn off **Show update notifications**.
4. Turn off **Auto updates** or recommendations.
ads_step_36_specialNote: Turn off auto-update and notifications in updater settings.
ads_step_37_detail: Removes cloud promotional banners, AI memory feeds, and unneeded background cloud synchronization prompts.
ads_step_37_steps:
1. Open **Gallery** app.
2. Tap the **3 dots** (top right) -> **Settings**.
3. Turn off **View cloud recommendations**.
4. Turn off **Memories push notifications**.
ads_step_37_specialNote: Essential system app. Keep app installed and manage in-app recommendations.
ads_step_38_detail: Disables background feedback diagnostics and cloud recommendation prompts in the Notes app.
ads_step_38_steps:
1. Open **Notes** app.
2. Tap the **3 dots** or **Profile** -> **Settings**.
3. Turn off **Sync feedback** and cloud suggestions.
ads_step_38_specialNote: You can manage cloud sync in notes settings.
ads_step_39_detail: A background security definitions updater that includes telemetry and tracking SDKs.
ads_step_39_steps:
1. Open phone **Settings** -> **Apps** -> **Manage Apps**.
2. Tap the 3 dots -> **Show all apps**.
3. Locate **Guard Provider** and restrict background data or notifications.
ads_step_39_specialNote: Can be managed in Manage Apps settings (com.miui.guardprovider).
ads_step_40_detail: Monitors device usage time, retention metrics, and app engagement for server-side user growth profiling.
ads_step_40_steps:
1. Open phone **Settings** -> **Passwords & security** -> **Authorization & revocation**.
2. Locate user engagement or growth services if listed.
3. You can also restrict background data in **Manage Apps**.
ads_step_40_specialNote: Background system service. Can be managed in app settings.
ads_step_41_detail: Background AI cognition service that monitors content on screen to serve personalized promotions.
ads_step_41_steps:
1. Open phone **Settings** -> **Apps** -> **Manage Apps**.
2. Tap the 3 dots -> **Show all apps**.
3. Locate **AiCr** or **AI Recognition** and restrict background data.
ads_step_41_specialNote: Background AI service. Can be restricted in app settings.
ads_step_42_detail: Disables aggressive push notifications promoting loans, insurance, and virtual coins.
ads_step_42_steps:
1. Open phone **Settings** -> **Apps** -> **Manage Apps**.
2. Search for **Payment** or **Mi Pay**.
3. Turn off **Notifications** and restrict background data.
ads_step_42_specialNote: Turn off notifications and marketing messages in Payment settings.
ads_step_43_detail: Collects battery usage patterns and scenario telemetry data for cloud profiling.
ads_step_43_steps:
1. Open phone **Settings** -> **Battery**.
2. Tap the **Settings icon** (top right).
3. Review app battery saver and turn off telemetry sharing.
ads_step_43_specialNote: Do not uninstall PowerKeeper as it manages system battery states.
ads_step_44_detail: Prevents persistent alerts urging upgrade to paid Mi Cloud storage tiers.
ads_step_44_steps:
1. Open phone **Settings** -> **Xiaomi Account** -> **Xiaomi Cloud**.
2. Tap on **Settings**.
3. Turn off **Storage reminder notifications**.
ads_step_44_specialNote: Manage cloud storage notifications without disabling account.
ads_step_45_detail: Pre-installed document viewer bundled with full-screen opening ads and diagnostic telemetry.
ads_step_45_steps:
1. Open **WPS Office** app.
2. Go to **Me** / **Profile** tab -> **Settings**.
3. Tap on **Notification Settings** and disable all promotional messages.
4. Or uninstall and replace with LibreOffice / Google Docs.
ads_step_45_specialNote: Can be disabled or uninstalled in Manage Apps if not needed.
ads_step_46_detail: Injects sponsored shopping and partner website bookmarks into default web browsers.
ads_step_46_steps:
1. Open your browser settings.
2. Go to **Bookmarks / Homepage**.
3. Remove unwanted partner bookmarks or reset homepage to default.
ads_step_46_specialNote: Manage browser bookmarks directly in your browser settings.
ads_step_47_detail: Pre-installed background daemons (App Manager, System, and Services) that run telemetry and silent updates even without the Facebook app.
ads_step_47_steps:
1. Open phone **Settings** -> **Apps** -> **Manage Apps**.
2. Tap the 3 dots (top right) -> **Show all apps**.
3. Search for **Facebook** (Services, App Manager, System).
4. Tap **Disable** or turn off **Background data** and notifications.
ads_step_47_specialNote: Can be disabled in App Settings without affecting device stability.
ads_step_48_detail: Collects detailed app usage analytics, screen dwell times, and click telemetry for user profiling.
ads_step_48_steps:
1. Open phone **Settings** -> **Passwords & security** -> **Authorization & revocation**.
2. Look for **OneTrack** or diagnostic services.
3. Or navigate to **Apps** -> **Manage Apps** -> **OneTrack** and restrict background data.
ads_step_48_specialNote: Background telemetry service. Can be restricted in app settings.
ads_step_49_detail: Promotional app store pushing game installation ads, popup banners, and background asset downloads.
ads_step_49_steps:
1. Open **Game Center** / **Xiaomi Games**.
2. Go to **Account** or **Profile** -> **Settings**.
3. Turn off **Push notifications** and **Personalized recommendations**.
4. You can also disable the app in **Manage Apps**.
ads_step_49_specialNote: Can be disabled or uninstalled in Manage Apps if not used.
ads_step_50_detail: Pre-installed forum application sending frequent promotional campaign alerts and marketing news.
ads_step_50_steps:
1. Open **Xiaomi Community**.
2. Go to **Profile** -> **Settings**.
3. Turn off **Push notifications**.
4. Or open **Settings** -> **Apps** -> **Manage Apps** and uninstall / disable it.
ads_step_50_specialNote: Safe to uninstall or disable if you do not participate in community forums.
ads_step_51_detail: Marketing platform pushing urgent loan promotions, credit score checks, and financial ads.
ads_step_51_steps:
1. Open phone **Settings** -> **Apps** -> **Manage Apps**.
2. Search for **Mi Credit** or **Mi Pay Wallet**.
3. Tap **Notifications** and turn them off.
4. Tap **Disable** or **Uninstall** if available.
ads_step_51_specialNote: Safe to disable or uninstall if you do not use Mi Credit.
ads_step_52_detail: Background engine analyzing on-device behavior to generate predictive ad targeting profiles.
ads_step_52_steps:
1. Open phone **Settings** -> **Passwords & security** -> **Privacy**.
2. Tap on **Ad services** and turn off **Personalized ad recommendations**.
3. Locate **Aireco** in **Manage Apps** (Show all apps) and restrict background data.
ads_step_52_specialNote: Background targeting service. Can be managed in privacy settings.
ads_step_53_subtitle: Remote ad and feature delivery daemon
ads_step_53_detail: Background daemon executing remote A/B experiments for dynamic promotional layouts and features.
ads_step_53_steps:
1. Open phone **Settings** -> **Apps** -> **Manage Apps**.
2. Tap the 3 dots -> **Show all apps**.
3. Locate **Xiaomi AB** and restrict background data or disable notifications.
ads_step_53_specialNote: Safe to restrict in app settings.
ads_step_54_subtitle: Instant web app ad delivery engine
ads_step_54_detail: Support daemon enabling instant app ads and automatic launcher shortcut placement.
ads_step_54_steps:
1. Open phone **Settings** -> **Apps** -> **Manage Apps**.
2. Tap 3 dots -> **Show all apps**.
3. Locate **Quick Apps Accessory**.
4. Revoke background permissions and notifications.
ads_step_54_specialNote: Can be restricted in Manage Apps.
ads_step_55_subtitle: International data and roaming sales prompts
ads_step_55_detail: Prompts to purchase virtual SIMs and data packages when traveling or switching network bands.
ads_step_55_steps:
1. Open phone **Settings** -> **SIM cards & mobile networks**.
2. Look for **Mi Roaming** or **Virtual SIM** settings.
3. Disable marketing notifications or restrict background data in **Manage Apps**.
ads_step_55_specialNote: Can be disabled in App Settings if roaming services are not needed.
ads_step_56_detail: Background reporting tool that prompts user satisfaction surveys and diagnostic collection.
ads_step_56_steps:
1. Open **Services & Feedback** app.
2. Tap the 3 dots -> **Settings**.
3. Turn off **Notification reminders** and diagnostic sharing.
ads_step_56_specialNote: Can be managed in app settings.
ads_step_57_detail: Pre-installed OEM input method sending search queries for advertising and online suggestion feeds.
ads_step_57_steps:
1. Open phone **Settings** -> **Additional settings** -> **Languages & input** -> **Manage keyboards**.
2. Switch your default keyboard to **Gboard**.
3. Disable or restrict **Sogou Keyboard** in **Manage Apps**.
ads_step_57_specialNote: Switch to Gboard before disabling pre-installed OEM keyboards.
ads_step_58_detail: Pre-installed casual partner games (such as Crazy Juicer, Block Puzzle, Ludo Saga) bundled in regional ROMs.
ads_step_58_steps:
1. Long press the game icon on your Home screen.
2. Tap **App info** -> **Uninstall**.
3. Or go to **Settings** -> **Apps** -> **Manage Apps** and uninstall them.
ads_step_59_detail: Background service responsible for downloading and injecting ads across MIUI system components.
ads_step_59_steps:
1. Open phone **Settings** -> **Apps** -> **Manage Apps**.
2. Tap the 3 dots (top right) -> **Show all apps**.
3. Search for **SystemAdSolution**.
4. Restrict **Background data** and disable notifications.
ads_step_59_specialNote: Can be restricted in Manage Apps to prevent system ad delivery.
ads_step_60_detail: Background engine analyzing on-screen text to serve contextually targeted promotional widgets.
ads_step_60_steps:
1. Open phone **Settings** -> **Apps** -> **Manage Apps**.
2. Tap 3 dots -> **Show all apps**.
3. Locate **Content Catcher** or **Content Extension**.
4. Turn off background permissions and data access.
ads_step_60_specialNote: Safe to restrict in app settings.
ads_step_61_detail: Voice assistant services running background microphone wake word listeners and cloud telemetry.
ads_step_61_steps:
1. Open phone **Settings** -> **Apps** -> **Manage Apps**.
2. Locate **Voice Assist** or **AI Assistant**.
3. Tap **Disable** or revoke all permissions.
ads_step_61_specialNote: Can be disabled if you use Google Assistant or no voice assistant.
ads_step_62_detail: Floating navigation shortcut ball bundled with promotional quick-launch buttons.
ads_step_62_steps:
1. Open phone **Settings** -> **Additional settings**.
2. Tap on **Quick ball**.
3. Toggle **Turn on Quick ball** to off.
ads_step_62_specialNote: Can be turned off in Additional Settings.
ads_step_63_detail: Proprietary push notification service frequently sending background keep-alive network requests.
ads_step_63_steps:
1. Open phone **Settings** -> **Apps** -> **Manage Apps**.
2. Tap 3 dots -> **Show all apps**.
3. Locate **Xiaomi Service Framework**.
4. Restrict background data and battery usage.
ads_step_63_specialNote: Do not uninstall completely if using Mi Account sync.
ads_step_64_detail: Cross-device screen casting and multicast discovery services that may cause standby battery drain.
ads_step_64_steps:
1. Open phone **Settings** -> **Connection & sharing**.
2. Turn off **Cast** and **Nearby devices** when not in use.
3. You can restrict **Mi Link** in **Manage Apps**.
ads_step_64_specialNote: Turn off when you do not need screen mirroring to save battery.
ads_step_65_subtitle: Sponsored TV guide and Peel ads
ads_step_65_detail: Infrared remote control app integrated with sponsored video feeds, recommendations, and Peel advertising.
ads_step_65_steps:
1. Open **Mi Remote** app.
2. Tap 3 dots (top right) -> **Settings**.
3. Turn off **Recommendations** and TV guide notifications.
4. Or disable the app in **Manage Apps**.
ads_step_65_specialNote: Can be disabled in Manage Apps if your phone lacks IR blaster.
ads_step_66_detail: Background translation daemons pre-installed to power clipboard and browser translation.
ads_step_66_steps:
1. Open phone **Settings** -> **Apps** -> **Manage Apps**.
2. Tap 3 dots -> **Show all apps**.
3. Search for **Translation**.
4. Disable or restrict background data.
ads_step_66_specialNote: Can be disabled in Manage Apps.
ads_step_67_subtitle: Promotional SMS cards and rich menus
ads_step_67_detail: Parses financial and marketing SMS messages to render interactive promotional cards and company logos.
ads_step_67_steps:
1. Open the **Messages** app.
2. Tap **Settings** (gear icon).
3. Turn off **Smart messaging** or **Promotional SMS cards**.
4. Restrict **SMS Extra** in **Manage Apps**.
ads_step_67_specialNote: Can be disabled in Messaging settings.
ads_step_68_detail: Background daemons collecting power metrics, crash reports, and system state diagnostics.
ads_step_68_steps:
1. Open phone **Settings** -> **Apps** -> **Manage Apps**.
2. Tap 3 dots -> **Show all apps**.
3. Search for **Power Checker** or **System Helper**.
4. Turn off background data.
ads_step_68_specialNote: Safe to restrict in app settings.
ads_step_69_detail: Background service monitoring speaker and headphone audio scenarios to report sound usage data.
ads_step_69_steps:
1. Open phone **Settings** -> **Apps** -> **Manage Apps**.
2. Tap 3 dots -> **Show all apps**.
3. Locate **Audio Monitor**.
4. Restrict background data.
ads_step_69_specialNote: Can be managed in app settings.
